variant: mono_neigh+blend fitted with Albufera's 15 Oct to 15 Nov 2026 passes
rain_source: Open-Meteo, ECMWF IFS 9 km, wettest lattice point of the site per day
validation_status: fit version: learned from Albufera's DANA passes, never from Pego-Oliva's; at Pego-Oliva out of sample; check in data/prediction/spatial/improve/fit_albufera_oct; not yet scored against EMSR935
mode_note: rain between issue and target is the rain that fell (IFS archive), not a forecast
score: relative water likelihood 0-1 learned from Sentinel-1 water maps; not a calibrated flood probability

files.water_likelihood_utm.tif: float32 0-1, NaN outside land, EPSG:32630 20 m
files.new_water_likelihood_utm.tif: the same, only where the previous water map says dry
files.water_likelihood_web.tif: uint8 0-100, 255 no data, Web Mercator COG
files.new_water_likelihood_web.tif: uint8 0-100, 255 no data, Web Mercator COG

evidence.0: prediction from terrain, rain and the previous water map
evidence.1: permanent water (JRC occurrence >= 90 %): context, not flooding
evidence.2: built-up land: radar water maps are unreliable here, so nothing was learned from towns; the value is extrapolated from fields
evidence.3: no water map before the issue time: new water cannot be told from old
evidence.4: rarely or never mapped by Sentinel-1 (terrain mask, shadow): extrapolated
evidence.255: sea or outside the land grid

native_resolution.rain: ECMWF IFS 9 km, one value per site and day
